content.title: Cboe Launches Continuous Bitcoin & Ether Futures
content.description: Cboe recently announced new continuous futures for bitcoin and ether, mimicking popular offshore perpetual contracts but with a key difference: they're long-dated, cash-settled products with a 10-year expiry. In today's Markets Outlook, CoinDesk's Jennifer Sanasie sits down with Cboe's Global Head of Derivatives, Catherine Clay, to dive into these innovative new products, plus Catherine shares key takeaways from the Hood Summit, including what today's retail traders are really after.

content.title: Bullish Bets on Warner Bros. Shares Hit Record Volumes
content.summary: Options traders are piling into bullish wagers on Warner Bros. Discovery after The Wall Street Journal reported that Paramount Skydance is preparing a bid for the company. More than 399,000 call options tied to the entertainment company changed hands on Thursday, a record, show Cboe Global Markets data.

content.title: Oracle Surge Lifts S&P 500 to New Record
content.summary: A breakneck rally in  Oracle  shares helped power the S&P 500 to another record, while a slide in  Apple  dragged down the Dow Jones Industrial Average.  The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday afternoon that OpenAI and Oracle signed a $300 billion computing deal, among the biggest cloud contracts ever signed.  Oracle added $247 billion in market value, surpassing  JPMorgan Chase  to become the 10th-largest company by market capitalization, according to Dow Jones Market Data.

content.title: Cboe Plans to Offer ‘Continuous’ Futures for Bitcoin, Ether
content.summary: Perpetual futures, which never expire, have long been the engine of offshore crypto bets, powering massive trading volume on venues such as Binance and OKX.  Cboe’s “continuous futures” aim to capture that demand in a regulated setting, offering contracts with 10-year terms and daily price adjustments.  The structure of the Cboe contracts is similar to the perpetual-style futures products made available by crypto exchange Coinbase Global Inc. earlier this year.
